tasks.title: Add formatCents
tasks.description: Format integer cents as US dollars: a $ sign, thousands separated by commas, always two decimals, a leading - for negatives.
scenarios: Given 123456 When formatCents is called Then it returns "$1,234.56"
Given -5 When formatCents is called Then it returns "-$0.05"
Given 0 When formatCents is called Then it returns "$0.00"
Given 100000000 When formatCents is called Then it returns "$1,000,000.00"
